params.description: The fully qualified ID of the scope for getting the resource links. For example, to list resource links at and under a resource group, set the scope to /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/myGroup.

params.description: The filter to apply when getting resource links. To get links only at the specified scope (not below the scope), use Filter.atScope().
